run_filtered_lrelu: run filtered_lrelu on a 4D tensor to apply upsampling, leaky ReLU activation, and downsampling in one fused op
run_filtered_lrelu_with_filters: run filtered_lrelu with custom FIR filter tensors for upsampling and downsampling on a batch of 2D images
run_filtered_lrelu_with_bias: run filtered_lrelu with a channel-specific bias vector and configurable gain, slope, and clamp parameters
test_filtered_lrelu_ref: test the reference implementation of filtered_lrelu using upfirdn2d and bias_act ops on a 4D input tensor
review_filtered_lrelu_cuda: review the FilteredLReluCuda autograd function that implements the fast CUDA path with sign tensor caching and gradient support
